title: Do individualists and collectivists cooperate differently?
title_zh: 个人主义者与集体主义者的合作方式是否不同？
title_primary: 个人主义者与集体主义者的合作方式是否不同？
title_secondary: Do individualists and collectivists cooperate differently?
authors: Aidin Hajikhameneh, Erik O. Kimbrough, Brock Stoddard
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-09-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Do cultural mindsets shape cooperation? Individualists, who view people as independent, and collectivists, who see them as interconnected, make different decisions that impact governance and economic outcomes. This study tests individualism and collectivism (I/C) in indefinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemmas (IRPD) among in- and out-group members. We hypothesized that collectivists would cooperate more with in-group members, while individualists would treat all groups similarly. To explore causality, participants completed a group-identity task before the I/C measure in Strong-Identity treatment, but not in Weak-Identity treatment. Results show largely null I/C effects; only higher defection payoffs consistently reduced cooperation. Some evidence supports the Strong-Identity treatment leading to lower defection in groups exhibiting greater cohesion in the group-identity task.
abstract_zh: 文化心态是否塑造合作行为？个人主义者视个体为独立存在，而集体主义者则视其为相互关联，这两种不同的观念会导致影响治理和经济结果的决策差异。本研究在无限重复囚徒困境（IRPD）中，针对群体内与群体外成员，测试了个人主义与集体主义（I/C）的影响。我们假设集体主义者会更多与群体内成员合作，而个人主义者则对所有群体一视同仁。为探究因果关系，在强身份处理组中，参与者在完成I/C测量前先执行群体身份任务；而在弱身份处理组中则无此任务。结果显示，I/C效应大体上不显著；唯有更高的背叛收益持续降低了合作率。部分证据支持强身份处理组在群体身份任务中表现出更高凝聚力的群体中，导致背叛率下降。

title: Civic Engagement as a Constraint on Corruption
title_zh: 公民参与对腐败的制约作用
title_primary: 公民参与对腐败的制约作用
title_secondary: Civic Engagement as a Constraint on Corruption
authors: Kenju Kamei, Louis Putterman, Katy Tabero, Jean-Robert Tyran
official: 官方在线 2025-01-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Corruption is the great disease of government. It undermines the efficiency of the public sector in many countries around the world. We experimentally study civic engagement (CE) as a constraint on corruption when incentives are stacked against providing CE. We show that CE is powerful in curbing corruption when citizens can encourage each other to provide CE through social approval. Social approval induces strategic complementarity among conditional cooperators which counteracts the strategic substitutability (which tends to limit beneficial effects of CE) built into our design. We also show that civic engagement in the lab is correlated with civic engagement in the field, and that the effects of social approval are surprisingly robust to framing in our setting.
abstract_zh: 腐败是政府的一大顽疾，它削弱了全球许多国家公共部门的效率。我们通过实验研究了当激励因素不利于公民参与（CE）时，公民参与如何作为对腐败的制约。研究表明，当公民能通过社会认可相互鼓励提供公民参与时，公民参与在遏制腐败方面效果显著。社会认可在条件合作者之间引发了策略互补性，这抵消了我们设计中固有的策略替代性（这种替代性往往限制公民参与的积极效果）。我们还发现，实验室中的公民参与与实际场域中的公民参与相关联，且在我们的设定中，社会认可的效果对框架的变动出人意料地稳健。

title: Social Media vs. Democracy: Evidence from the January 6th Insurrection
title_zh: 社交媒体与民主：来自1月6日暴乱的证据
title_primary: 社交媒体与民主：来自1月6日暴乱的证据
title_secondary: Social Media vs. Democracy: Evidence from the January 6th Insurrection
authors: Karsten Müller, Carlo Schwarz, Zekai Shen
official: 官方在线 2026-02-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Social media platforms are often credited with empowering grassroots movements in the pursuit of political freedoms. In this paper, we show how social media can also be exploited by political elites to undermine democratic institutions, using the January 6th, 2021 Capitol insurrection as a case study. We present three main findings. First, by exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in Twitter usage, we document that social media exposure predicts participation in the Capitol attack, donations for anti-democratic causes, beliefs in election fraud, and support for the January 6th rioters. Second, Donald Trump's tweets questioning the election's integrity were followed by spikes in "Stop the Steal" activity on Twitter and pro-Trump donations originating from high Twitter usage counties. Third, the insurrection and Trump's account deletion were followed by a decrease in the public expression of toxic political and "Stop the Steal" messaging by pro-Trump users on Twitter, but had little effect on privately held beliefs about the election outcome and pro-Trump donations.
abstract_zh: 社交媒体平台常被视为赋能草根运动、追求政治自由的工具。本文以2021年1月6日国会山暴乱为案例，展示社交媒体如何被政治精英利用以削弱民主制度。我们提出三项主要发现。首先，通过利用Twitter使用中看似外生的变异，我们记录了社交媒体接触能预测参与国会山袭击、为反民主事业捐款、相信选举舞弊以及支持1月6日暴乱者的行为。其次，唐纳德·特朗普质疑选举公正性的推文之后，Twitter上“停止偷窃”活动及来自高Twitter使用率县的支持特朗普捐款出现激增。第三，暴乱事件及特朗普账号被删除后，Twitter上支持特朗普用户公开发表的毒性政治及“停止偷窃”信息有所减少，但对私下持有的关于选举结果及支持特朗普捐款的信念影响甚微。

title: A Unified Urban Model With Non-Homothetic Housing Demand
title_zh: 非位似住房需求下的统一城市模型
title_primary: 非位似住房需求下的统一城市模型
title_secondary: A Unified Urban Model With Non-Homothetic Housing Demand
authors: Frédéric Robert-Nicoud, Pierre-Philippe Combes, Gilles Duranton, Laurent Gobillon
official: 官方在线 2026-02-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Abstract Canonical urban models fail to jointly account for flexible housing demand, non-degenerate city sizes, and observed urban systems. We introduce a unifying urban framework based on price-independent generalized linear (PIGL) preferences in which housing is a necessity. Non-homothetic housing demand generates income effects that cause urban costs to scale more strongly with population than wages, restoring a unique interior efficient city size under standard assumptions. The framework nests existing canonical models, remains tractable, and is consistent with key empirical regularities, including Zipf’s law and observed housing price elasticities. We also encapsulate a monocentric city model into our framework.
abstract_zh: 摘要 经典城市模型未能同时解释灵活的住房需求、非退化城市规模及观察到的城市体系。我们引入一个基于价格独立广义线性（PIGL）偏好的统一城市框架，其中住房为必需品。非齐次住房需求产生收入效应，导致城市成本随人口增长的幅度超过工资，从而在标准假设下恢复唯一的内生有效城市规模。该框架涵盖现有经典模型，保持可操作性，并与关键经验规律（包括齐普夫定律和观察到的住房价格弹性）相一致。我们还将单中心城市模型纳入此框架。

title: Skills, Not Scale: GenAI and Technology Adoption
title_zh: 技能，而非规模：生成式人工智能与技术采纳
title_primary: 技能，而非规模：生成式人工智能与技术采纳
title_secondary: Skills, Not Scale: GenAI and Technology Adoption
authors: Nuriye Melisa Bilgin, Gianmarco Ottaviano
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Do the determinants of technology adoption depend on technological architecture? Using administrative data on Turkish firms from 2021 to 2024, we compare the adoption of traditional and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI). We show that GenAI adoption is driven by workforce skill intensity and is not positively associated with firm size, whereas traditional AI depends on both scale and skills. Firms that adopt both technologies are distinct and represent the most persistent adoption mode. Conditional on adoption, the skill-to-size ratio governs technology choice, and transition dynamics indicate a sequential process in which firms adopt GenAI before expanding to hybrid use. Exploiting the release of ChatGPT as a quasi-experimental reduction in access costs, we find that high-skill firms differentially increased GenAI adoption, while firm size played a limited role. These results suggest that the canonical size-based diffusion pattern is not universal but depends on the cost structure of technologies, with implications for innovation policy and productivity dispersion.
abstract_zh: 技术采纳的决定因素是否取决于技术架构？利用2021至2024年土耳其企业的行政数据，我们比较了传统人工智能与生成式人工智能（GenAI）的采纳情况。我们发现，GenAI的采纳受劳动力技能密集度驱动，且与企业规模无正相关关系，而传统人工智能则同时依赖于规模与技能。同时采纳两种技术的企业具有独特性，并代表了最持久的采纳模式。在条件于采纳的情况下，技能与规模之比主导技术选择，且转换动态表明存在一个序贯过程，即企业先采纳GenAI，再扩展至混合使用。利用ChatGPT发布作为获取成本准实验性降低的契机，我们发现高技能企业差异化地增加了GenAI采纳，而企业规模作用有限。这些结果表明，基于规模的经典扩散模式并非普遍适用，而是取决于技术的成本结构，这对创新政策和生产率离散度具有启示意义。

title: Welfare Implications of a Carbon Tax in a Long-Distance Passenger Market
title_zh: 长途客运市场中碳税的福利影响
title_primary: 长途客运市场中碳税的福利影响
title_secondary: Welfare Implications of a Carbon Tax in a Long-Distance Passenger Market
authors: Frédéric Cherbonnier, Marc Ivaldi, Catherine Muller-Vibes, Karine Van Der Straeten, William Parker 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study estimates the impact of a carbon tax on welfare, considering modal shifts to less carbon-intensive transport, as well as its effects on environmental and fiscal externalities. We calibrate a modal competition model using logit demand functions for a specific long-distance connection in France and simulate the introduction of a Pigouvian tax. Our key findings are: First, a €190/tCO2 carbon tax is nearly welfare-neutral but significantly detrimental to consumer surplus; Second, rail price regulation has the side effect of reducing greenhouse gas emissions by subsidizing the cleanest transport mode; Third, the widespread adoption of electric vehicles enhances overall welfare without significantly harming consumer surplus.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了碳税对福利的影响，同时考虑了向低碳密集型交通方式的转变，以及其对环境和财政外部性的效应。我们利用逻辑需求函数，针对法国某特定长途线路校准了一个交通方式竞争模型，并模拟了庇古税的引入。主要发现如下：第一，每吨二氧化碳190欧元的碳税几乎对福利中性，但对消费者剩余显著不利；第二，铁路价格管制通过补贴最清洁的交通方式，附带减少了温室气体排放；第三，电动汽车的广泛普及提升了整体福利，且未显著损害消费者剩余。

title: Fragmented urban food governance and impacts on the marginalisation of indigenous crops in Ghana
title_zh: 碎片化的城市食品治理及其对加纳本土作物边缘化的影响
title_primary: 碎片化的城市食品治理及其对加纳本土作物边缘化的影响
title_secondary: Fragmented urban food governance and impacts on the marginalisation of indigenous crops in Ghana
authors: Gideon Baffoe, Selorm Yaotse Dorvlo, Abena Boakye, Eleanor Jew, Philip Antwi-Agyei 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Indigenous crops remain visible within the markets and cultivation spaces of many African cities, yet their institutional positioning within urban food systems remains under-examined. While frequently recognised for their nutritional, ecological, and socio-cultural value, little is known about how these crops are currently embedded within urban governance structures. This paper investigates how indigenous crops are integrated into Accra’s urban food system and why they remain structurally marginal within urban food governance frameworks. Drawing on 35 semi-structured interviews with farmers, market actors, agricultural officials, researchers, municipal authorities, and land-use planning actors, we adopt a multi-actor qualitative approach to examine the governance conditions shaping indigenous crop production, circulation and support. The findings show that indigenous crops persist in Accra largely through informal retail networks, direct farmer–buyer relations, and small-scale cultivation in improvised urban spaces. Their presence in markets and cultivation sites does not, however, translate into coordinated institutional support. Farmers grow selected indigenous crops where demand is reliable, while crops perceived as less profitable, harder to prepare, or less compatible with changing urban consumption practices receive weaker market support. Agricultural institutions acknowledge indigenous crops, yet municipal planning and land governance systems rarely incorporate them explicitly into policy frameworks, resulting in institutional diffusion rather than coordinated support. The analysis conceptualises this condition as fragmented urban food governance – a situation in which responsibilities for food production, land-use planning, and market development operate in parallel but without deliberate alignment. Indigenous crops thus persist through informal practices and local initiative, yet remain peripheral within formal governance structures. By showing how indigenous crops are sustained through informality but remain weakly embedded in coordinated policy and planning systems, the paper contributes to debates on policy integration and guides on how to improve the resilience of urban food system transformation in rapidly urbanising African contexts.
abstract_zh: 本土作物在许多非洲城市的市场和种植空间中依然可见，但其在城市食品系统中的制度定位仍未得到充分研究。尽管这些作物因其营养、生态和社会文化价值而常获认可，但关于它们当前如何嵌入城市治理结构的知识却十分有限。本文探讨了本土作物如何融入阿克拉的城市食品系统，以及为何它们在城市食品治理框架中仍处于结构性边缘地位。基于对农民、市场参与者、农业官员、研究人员、市政当局和土地利用规划行动者的35次半结构化访谈，我们采用多行动者定性方法，考察了影响本土作物生产、流通和支持的治理条件。研究结果表明，阿克拉的本土作物主要通过非正规零售网络、农民与买家直接关系以及临时城市空间中的小规模种植得以存续。然而，它们在市场和种植场所的存在并未转化为协调的制度支持。农民在需求可靠的条件下种植选定的本土作物，而被认为利润较低、制备更困难或与不断变化的城市消费习惯兼容性较差的作物则获得较弱的市场支持。农业机构承认本土作物，但市政规划和土地治理系统很少将其明确纳入政策框架，导致制度分散而非协调支持。分析将此状况概念化为碎片化的城市食品治理——即食品生产、土地利用规划和市场发展的责任并行运作，却缺乏有意的协调一致。因此，本土作物通过非正规实践和地方主动性得以存续，但在正式治理结构中仍处于边缘地位。通过展示本土作物如何依赖非正规性得以维持，却未能深度嵌入协调的政策和规划系统，本文为政策整合的讨论作出贡献，并为在快速城市化的非洲背景下提升城市食品系统转型的韧性提供指导。

title: Stochastic Sequential Screening
title_zh: 随机序贯筛选
title_primary: 随机序贯筛选
title_secondary: Stochastic Sequential Screening
authors: Hao Li, Xianwen Shi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a sequential screening model with discrete ex ante types and continuously distributed ex post values. The approach — solving a relaxed problem by pointwise maximization and focusing on deterministic cutoffs — relies on strong regularity conditions and can fail when they are violated. We develop an alternative method that retains local incentive constraints, allowing deterministic and stochastic mechanisms, and derive surplus-to-slack ratio tests that identify each case. We propose the weak alignment condition, a strengthening of first-order stochastic dominance that guarantees stochastic allocations respect global incentive constraints, and the strong alignment condition, under which the gap between deterministic and stochastic conditions closes. We extend the analysis to a continuum of types and solve for optimal mechanisms in the three-type case under additional shape restrictions on the surplus-to-slack ratios. Our results show that randomization can be essential and tractable in optimal dynamic mechanisms when regularity fails.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个序贯筛选模型，其中事前类型为离散分布，事后价值为连续分布。该方法——通过逐点最大化求解松弛问题并聚焦于确定性截断——依赖于强正则条件，当这些条件被违反时可能失效。我们开发了一种替代方法，保留局部激励约束，允许确定性和随机机制，并推导出盈余-松弛比检验，以识别每种情形。我们提出了弱对齐条件，这是对一阶随机占优的强化，确保随机分配尊重全局激励约束，以及强对齐条件，在该条件下，确定性与随机条件之间的差距得以闭合。我们将分析扩展到连续类型情形，并在对盈余-松弛比施加额外形状限制的情况下，求解了三类型案例中的最优机制。我们的结果表明，当正则性失效时，随机化在最优动态机制中可能是必要且可处理的。

title: On the Limits of Chronological Age
title_zh: 论时间年龄的局限性
title_primary: 论时间年龄的局限性
title_secondary: On the Limits of Chronological Age
authors: Kotschy, Rainer, Bloom, David, Scott, Andrew, Kotschy, Rainer Franz
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Analysis of population aging is typically framed in terms of chronological age. However, chronological age itself is not necessarily deeply informative about the aging process. This paper reviews literature and conducts empirical analyses aimed at investigating whether chronological age is a reliable proxy for physiological functioning when used in models of economic behavior and outcomes. We show that chronological age is an unreliable proxy for physiological functioning due to appreciable differences in how aging unfolds across people, health domains, and over time. We further demonstrate that chronological age either fails to predict economic variables when used in lieu of physiological functioning, or that it predicts additional effects on economic behavior and outcomes that are largely unrelated to physiological aging. Continued reliance on chronological age as a proxy for physiological functioning might impede the ability of societies to fully harness the benefits of increasing longevity.
abstract_zh: 人口老龄化的分析通常以实际年龄为框架。然而，实际年龄本身并不一定对老龄化过程具有深刻的信息价值。本文回顾相关文献并进行实证分析，旨在探究在实际年龄作为经济行为与结果模型中的代理变量时，其是否能可靠地反映生理功能。我们表明，由于老龄化在不同人群、健康领域及时间维度上的显著差异，实际年龄作为生理功能的代理指标并不可靠。进一步地，我们证明，当实际年龄替代生理功能使用时，要么无法预测经济变量，要么预测出的经济行为与结果额外效应与生理老龄化基本无关。持续依赖实际年龄作为生理功能的代理变量，可能会阻碍社会充分利用寿命延长带来的益处。

title: DP12122 Populism and Central Bank Independence
title_zh: 民粹主义与中央银行独立性
title_primary: 民粹主义与中央银行独立性
title_secondary: DP12122 Populism and Central Bank Independence
authors: Charles Goodhart, Rosa Lastra
official: 官方在线 2017-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The consensus that surrounded the granting of central bank independence in the pursuit of a price stability oriented monetary policy has been challenged in the aftermath of the global financial crisis, in the light of the rise of populism on the one hand and the expanded mandates of central banks on the other hand. After considering the economic case for independence and the three Ds (distributional, directional and duration effects), the paper examines three different dimensions in the debate of how the rise in populism - or simply general discontent with the status quo - affects central bank independence. Finally, the paper examines how to interpret the legality of central bank mandates, and whether or not central banks have exceeded their powers. This analysis leads us in turn to consider accountability and, in particular, the judicial review of central bank actions and decisions. It is important to have in place adequate mechanisms to ‘guard the guardians’ of monetary and financial stability.
abstract_zh: 围绕追求价格稳定导向的货币政策而授予中央银行独立性的共识，在全球金融危机后受到了挑战，一方面是由于民粹主义的兴起，另一方面则是中央银行职责范围的扩大。在考量了支持独立性的经济理由及三个D（分配效应、方向效应和持续时间效应）之后，本文探讨了民粹主义抬头——或仅仅是对现状普遍不满——如何影响中央银行独立性的辩论中的三个不同维度。最后，本文审视了如何解读中央银行职责的合法性，以及中央银行是否超越了其权限。这一分析进而引导我们考虑问责制，特别是对中央银行行动与决策的司法审查。建立适当的机制来“守护货币与金融稳定的守护者”至关重要。

title: Foreign exporters absorbed nearly half of the 2025 US tariff shock
title_zh: 外国出口商吸收了2025年美国关税冲击的近一半
title_primary: 外国出口商吸收了2025年美国关税冲击的近一半
title_secondary: Foreign exporters absorbed nearly half of the 2025 US tariff shock
authors: Caroline Freund
official: 官方在线 2026-08-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: When the US imposed sweeping tariff increases in 2025, most economic forecasters predicted a sharp rise in consumer prices and significant import disruption. Instead, retail prices rose modestly and import-dependent sectors held up. This column uses data for the 50 largest US trading partners to show that foreign exporters absorbed roughly 40–50% of the 2025 US tariff increases through lower export prices – much more than earlier studies suggested. The absorption was highly unequal: dominant suppliers bore the bulk, while smaller ones passed the tariff on almost fully. The aggregate result vindicates optimal tariff theory. It does not mean the tariffs made America better off.
abstract_zh: 当美国于2025年实施大规模关税上调时，多数经济预测者预计消费者价格将急剧上升，进口将遭受重大干扰。然而，零售价格仅温和上涨，依赖进口的行业也保持了稳定。本文利用美国前50大贸易伙伴的数据表明，外国出口商通过降低出口价格吸收了2025年美国关税上调的约40%至50%——这一比例远高于早期研究的估计。这种吸收效应极不均衡：主导供应商承担了大部分负担，而较小的供应商则几乎将关税完全转嫁出去。总体结果印证了最优关税理论。但这并不意味着关税使美国变得更富裕。

title: The Brexit Vote, Productivity Growth and Macroeconomic Adjustments in the United Kingdom
title_zh: 英国脱欧公投、生产率增长与英国宏观经济调整
title_primary: 英国脱欧公投、生产率增长与英国宏观经济调整
title_secondary: The Brexit Vote, Productivity Growth and Macroeconomic Adjustments in the United Kingdom
authors: Ben Broadbent, Federico Di Pace, Thomas Drechsel, Richard Harrison, Silvana Tenreyro
official: 官方在线 2026-01-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The UK economy experienced significant macroeconomic adjustments following the 2016 referendum on its withdrawal from the European Union. To understand these adjustments, this paper presents empirical facts using novel UK macroeconomic data and estimates a small open economy model with tradable and non-tradable sectors. We demonstrate that the referendum outcome can be interpreted as news about a future decline in productivity growth in the tradable sector. An immediate fall in the relative price of non-tradable goods induces a temporary “sweet spot” for tradable producers. Economic activity in the tradable sector expands in the short run, while the non-tradable sector contracts. Aggregate output, consumption and investment growth decelerate.
abstract_zh: 英国经济在2016年关于退出欧盟的公投后经历了显著的宏观经济调整。为理解这些调整，本文利用新颖的英国宏观经济数据呈现实证事实，并估算了一个包含可贸易与非可贸易部门的小型开放经济模型。我们证明，公投结果可被解读为关于可贸易部门未来生产率增长下降的消息。非可贸易品相对价格的即时下跌为可贸易生产者创造了一个暂时的“甜蜜点”。短期内，可贸易部门的经济活动扩张，而非可贸易部门则收缩。总产出、消费和投资增长均放缓。

title: Unemployment, inequality, and Africans’ expectations about future economic prospects
title_zh: 失业、不平等与非洲人对未来经济前景的预期
title_primary: 失业、不平等与非洲人对未来经济前景的预期
title_secondary: Unemployment, inequality, and Africans’ expectations about future economic prospects
authors: Kossi Hyacinthe Boko, Livingstone Sedjro Geoffroy Boko, Muhammad Mohiuddin, Segnon Aguey
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the relationship between unemployment, income inequality, and Africans’ expectations about future economic prospects, highlighting how structural exclusion and labour market inefficiencies shape perceived opportunities, optimism, and confidence. Using Afrobarometer individual-level survey data combined with country-level macroeconomic indicators, ordinary least squares estimates reveal that Africans’ expectations regarding their countries’ future economic prospects are more strongly and negatively associated with unemployment than with the level of income inequality prevailing in their countries. Specifically, a one-percentage-point increase in unemployment is associated with a 0.026-point decrease in respondents’ optimism expectations regarding economic outlook. In addition, there is limited evidence that inequality substantially moderates the relationship between unemployment and expectations. Robustness checks using ordered logit models, a leave-one-country-out exercise, and logit models, confirm the consistency of the findings. However, robustness checks based on aggregating individuals’ perceptions at country-year level data suggest that the relationship between unemployment, inequality, and economic expectations is primarily driven by individual-level variation, underscoring the importance of micro-level heterogeneity in studying perceptions of future economic conditions. The findings suggest that African policymakers should prioritize addressing unemployment challenges to restore optimism, even where inequality remains unresolved. The authors are grateful to participants and discussants for their valuable comments and suggestions, which helped improve the quality of this study.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了失业、收入不平等与非洲人对未来经济前景预期之间的关系，揭示了结构性排斥和劳动力市场低效如何塑造感知机会、乐观情绪和信心。利用非洲晴雨表个人层面调查数据，结合国家层面宏观经济指标，普通最小二乘估计显示，非洲人对本国未来经济前景的预期与失业率的负向关联强于与本国收入不平等水平的关联。具体而言，失业率每上升一个百分点，受访者对经济前景的乐观预期下降0.026个点。此外，仅有有限证据表明不平等显著调节失业与预期之间的关系。采用有序Logit模型、逐一剔除国家检验及Logit模型的稳健性检验证实了研究结果的一致性。然而，基于将个人感知聚合至国家-年份层面的稳健性检验表明，失业、不平等与经济预期之间的关系主要由个人层面变异驱动，凸显了微观层面异质性在研究未来经济条件感知中的重要性。研究结果表明，非洲政策制定者应优先解决失业挑战以恢复乐观情绪，即使不平等问题尚未解决。关键词：不平等；失业；预期；非洲 JEL分类：E24 D63 D84 O55 致谢 本文曾在加拿大经济科学学会（SCSE）第65届年会及法裔加拿大科学促进协会（ACFAS）第93届大会上报告。作者感谢与会者和评论人的宝贵意见与建议，这些帮助提升了本研究的质量。

title: The Comparative Travel Expenditure Method for Ecosystem Accounting

title_primary: 生态系统核算的比较旅行支出法

authors: Bartolini, Alice, Ferrini, Silvia, Fezzi, Carlo
official: 官方在线 2026-08-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper introduces the Comparative Travel Expenditure (CTE) method, a novel approach to derive exchange values for recreation-related ecosystem services (RES) compliant with the System of Environmental Economic Accounting - Ecosystem Accounting framework. Our approach builds upon the environmental economic literature by modifying the established travel-cost method in order to only consider market transactions to estimate the expenditures directly attributable to RES. By comparing the recreation demand of two sites with different ecosystem conditions, the CTE method allows us to estimate the difference in price driven by such differences in ecosystem conditions, thereby isolating the exchange value of RES for accounting purposes. To illustrate the CTE method, we conduct an empirical estimation of the RES exchange value of an Italian marine protected area, estimating that 66% of the travel expenditures incurred by tourists are driven by marine and coastal ecosystems, which significantly contribute to the local economy.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的“比较旅行支出”（CTE）方法，旨在推导符合《环境经济核算体系-生态系统核算》框架的休闲相关生态系统服务（RES）交换价值。该方法在环境经济学文献基础上，通过修改既有的旅行成本法，仅考虑市场交易来估算直接归因于RES的支出。通过比较两个生态系统条件不同的地点的休闲需求，CTE方法使我们能够估算由生态系统条件差异引起的价格差异，从而为核算目的分离出RES的交换价值。为说明CTE方法，我们对意大利一个海洋保护区的RES交换价值进行了实证估算，结果显示，游客旅行支出中有66%由海洋和沿海生态系统驱动，这些生态系统对当地经济贡献显著。

title: Market Regulation, Cycles, and Growth Dynamics in a Monetary Union
title_zh: 货币联盟中的市场监管、周期与增长动态
title_primary: 货币联盟中的市场监管、周期与增长动态
title_secondary: Market Regulation, Cycles, and Growth Dynamics in a Monetary Union
authors: MIRKO ABBRITTI, SEBASTIAN WEBER
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We build a two‐country currency union dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model with endogenous growth to assess the role of product market regulation (PMR) and labor market regulation (LMR) for growth and the adjustment to shocks. We show that with endogenous growth, there is no reason to expect real income convergence. Large shocks can lead to permanent changes of output and real exchange rates. Differences are exacerbated by different PMR and LMR. Less regulated economies have higher trend growth and recover faster from negative shocks. Results are consistent with higher inflation, lower employment, and disappointing total factor productivity (TFP) growth rates experienced in more regulated euro area members.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含内生增长的两国货币联盟动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，以评估产品市场监管（PMR）和劳动力市场监管（LMR）对经济增长及冲击调整的作用。研究表明，在内生增长条件下，实际收入趋同并无必然性。大规模冲击可能导致产出与实际汇率的永久性变化。不同的产品市场监管与劳动力市场监管会加剧这种差异。监管程度较低的经济体具有更高的趋势增长率，且能从负面冲击中更快恢复。这一结果与监管更严格的欧元区成员国所经历的高通胀、低就业以及令人失望的全要素生产率（TFP）增长率表现相一致。

abstract: this paper employs a microeconomic cross-section, a sub-sample of some 2,400 adult males drawn from the New Survey of London Life and Labour, conducted between 1928 and 1931. official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study central bank asset purchases (APs) in bond markets where rational investors face position limits and learn from private signals and market prices. APs affect information aggregation, altering the informativeness of prices and their sensitivity to fundamentals through an information channel distinct from risk-premium effects. Consistent with this mechanism, we find that U.S. Federal Reserve APs strengthened the pass-through of labor market news to Treasury yields. Dispersed beliefs and position limits also provide a microfoundation for the optimality of APs.
abstract_zh: 我们研究理性投资者面临头寸限制并从私人信号和市场价格中学习的债券市场中，央行资产购买（APs）的影响。资产购买通过一个区别于风险溢价效应的信息渠道，影响信息聚合，改变价格的信息含量及其对基本面的敏感度。与这一机制一致，我们发现美联储资产购买增强了劳动力市场消息对国债收益率的传导效应。信念分散与头寸限制也为资产购买的最优性提供了微观基础。

official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the liquidity choice of a bank subject to rollover risk and support from a lender of last resort (LLR) and study the consequences for bank stability, funding costs, and liquidity regulation. The liquidity choice balances forgoing profitable yet illiquid investment with fewer panic runs and cheaper debt. A higher LLR penalty rate increases bank liquidity and has a V-shaped effect on ex-ante bank stability. Turning to normative implications, the availability of the LLR reduces welfare for a large social cost of bank failure. The anticipation of ex-post support mitigates panic runs but induces lower bank liquidity ex ante, which increases funding costs and the frequency of bank failure. Liquidity regulation aligns private with social incentives and increases the social value of LLR support.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一家面临展期风险并接受最后贷款人（LLR）支持的银行的流动性选择，并探讨了其对银行稳定性、融资成本及流动性监管的影响。流动性选择需要在放弃盈利但缺乏流动性的投资与减少恐慌性挤兑及降低债务成本之间进行权衡。更高的LLR惩罚利率会提升银行流动性，并对事前银行稳定性产生V形效应。从规范意义上看，LLR的可得性在银行破产社会成本较高时会降低社会福利。对事后支持的预期虽能缓解恐慌性挤兑，但会降低银行事前流动性，从而增加融资成本及银行破产频率。流动性监管能够协调私人激励与社会激励，并提升LLR支持的社会价值。

official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a tractable quantitative model of international trade in which agents make bilateral investments in resilience under general equilibrium uncertainty. Under both complete and incomplete financial markets, we show that these bilateral investments solve a portfolio problem of choosing trade partners. Countries' risk profiles become determinants of trade flows, income and welfare, whose first moments are affected by the second moments of productivity and trade costs. Changes in global economic uncertainty have heterogeneous effects across countries, depending on how they affect real hedging opportunities. The opening of trade can raise or reduce income volatility, but is revealed-preferred to autarky.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个可量化的国际贸易模型，其中经济主体在一般均衡不确定性下对韧性进行双边投资。在完全金融市场与不完全金融市场两种情形下，我们证明这些双边投资可归结为选择贸易伙伴的投资组合问题。国家的风险特征成为决定贸易流、收入与福利的关键因素，而这些变量的第一矩受生产率与贸易成本第二矩的影响。全球经济不确定性的变化对不同国家产生异质性效应，其影响方向取决于这些变化如何改变实际对冲机会。贸易开放可能提高或降低收入波动性，但通过显示性偏好分析可知，其福利水平优于自给自足状态。

title: The Effect of Omitted Variables on the Sign of Regression Coefficients

authors: Matthew A. Masten, Alexandre Poirier
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that, depending on how the impact of omitted variables is measured, it can be substantially easier for omitted variables to flip coefficient signs than to drive them to zero. This behavior occurs with “Oster's delta” (Oster 2019a), a widely reported robustness measure. Consequently, any time this measure is large—suggesting omitted variables may be unimportant—a much smaller value reverses the sign of the parameter of interest. We propose a modified measure of robustness to address this concern. We illustrate our results in four empirical applications and two meta-analyses. We implement our methods in the companion Stata module “regsensitivity.” (JEL C18, C21, C52)
abstract_zh: 我们证明，根据遗漏变量影响的衡量方式不同，遗漏变量翻转系数符号的难度可能远低于将其归零的难度。这一现象出现在广泛使用的稳健性指标“奥斯特德尔塔”（Oster 2019a）中。因此，每当该指标数值较大（表明遗漏变量可能不重要）时，一个更小的数值即可逆转目标参数的符号。我们提出了一种修正的稳健性度量方法以解决这一问题。我们通过四个实证应用和两项元分析展示了研究结果，并在配套的Stata模块“regsensitivity”中实现了相关方法。（JEL C18, C21, C52）

official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using newly collected discount rate data for six Swiss cities from 1846 to 1893, we find no evidence of increasing integration during a 30‐year period of lightly regulated free banking. We attribute this to two structural issues: banks had incentives to ward off competitors by protecting their local monopolies or forming cartels, and there was always a risk (which varied across banks) that banknotes were not accepted or converted at par. We use a novel counterfactual to show that these issues increased discount rate dispersion, and argue that as a result, public regulation of payments infrastructure was necessary for money market integration.

abstract: This paper estimates Korea's long-run real neutral interest rate and quantifies the structural forces behind its decline since 1990. abstract: This paper provides causal evidence on how pension income affects labor supply after retirement. We exploit the introduction of the German Earned Income Pension Credit (Grundrente), which permanently increased pension income for retirees with long contribution histories and comparatively low lifetime earnings. The reform generates exogenous variation in non-labor income without creating additional labor supply distortions, allowing us to isolate pure income effects. Using administrative data covering the universe of German retirees and a difference-in-differences design, we find that a 1,200 euro increase in annual pension income reduces unconditional labor earnings by approximately 122 euros, implying a marginal propensity to earn out of unearned income of -0.1. Two thirds of this response reflects extensive margin adjustments, which operate through both increased exit and reduced re-entry, with the remainder driven by intensive margin reductions. Effects are stronger for younger, more labor-market-attached cohorts.

abstract: We study empirically and theoretically the effects of international financial flows on resource allocation. abstract: We study the intergenerational distributional effects of carbon pricing during the green transition in an overlapping-generations New Keynesian model calibrated to euro-area household micro data. Climate policy generates systematic redistribution across cohorts through two channels: a labor-income channel, driven by wage compression and lower labor demand, and a financial-wealth channel, driven by asset revaluation and higher real returns. The labor- income channel dominates quantitatively , generating persistent welfare losses of up to 6 percent in permanent-consumption equivalents for working-age households, while retirees experience comparable gains. Revenue recycling can mitigate these asymmetries, requiring 40 to 68 per- cent of carbon-tax revenues to be directed toward financial-income tax relief. Monetary policy has limited influence on the overall redistributive pattern.

abstract: We explore the negative balance sheet effect of foreign currency borrowing on the exchange rate pass-through to domestic prices. Exploiting a large, unexpected depreciation episode in Korea in 1997, we show that firms with higher foreign currency debt experience balance sheet deterioration and face lower growth rates of net worth, sales, and markups. We then empirically document that sectors populated by firms with higher foreign currency debt exposure prior to the depreciation exhibit larger price increases. Building a heterogeneous-firm model with financial constraints, we quantify the role of foreign currency debt in explaining the exchange rate pass-through to prices and find that 10% to 44% of sectoral price changes during the depreciation episode can be explained by the balance sheet effect of foreign currency debt alone. We emphasize the role of strategic complementarity in amplifying sectoral price increases.

abstract: Addressing household energy poverty is essential for improving quality of life and achieving sustainable development, yet limited evidence exists on the role of FinTech in alleviating it at the household level. We find that FinTech adoption significantly reduces energy poverty, with stronger effects observed among households with middle-aged heads, smaller sizes, and higher financial literacy, as well as those located in eastern regions or digitally advanced cities. abstract: How Western donors respond to China’s expanding development finance remains contested, with competing hypotheses and limited systematic evidence. This study estimates the effect of Chinese aid on bilateral official development assistance (ODA) provided by donors in the OECD Development Assistance Committee (OECD-DAC). Using a Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood estimator on a four-dimensional panel covering 31 donors, 130 recipients, and 13 sectors from 2001 to 2019, the analysis exploits within-recipient-sector-year variation in Chinese aid shocks and incorporates an extensive set of multi-way fixed effects to address endogeneity concerns. While no average competitive response is detected across all donors, we find consistent evidence that Japan systematically increased its ODA commitments in reaction to Chinese engagement—amounting to an estimated US$ 49.2â€¯billion, or 22% of Japan’s total ODA commitments during the study period. Japan’s competitive responses are concentrated in geographically proximate and more democratic recipients, consistent with its geopolitical and normative priorities. No comparable response is detected for other major OECD-DAC donors, including the United States, Germany, France, and the United Kingdom. Taken together, the results show that Japan’s behaviour illustrates how a traditional donor can strategically deploy ODA as part of a broader foreign policy and industrial strategy, while the muted responses of other donors suggest that the OECD-DAC system remains more resilient than often assumed.

abstract: We examine whether financial disclosures affect firm sustainability practices. Using mandatory segment reporting in the United States as the setting, we find that disclosing financial information about previously hidden segments in polluting industries reduces toxic emissions from firm plants. Disclosing firms achieve this reduction by implementing better pollution prevention practices, reducing waste generation, and increasing green innovation. Overall, our study highlights the role of mandatory financial disclosures in shaping corporate practices beyond the scope of the disclosed information.
abstract_zh: 我们考察财务披露是否影响企业的可持续实践。以美国强制分部报告为背景，我们发现，披露此前隐藏的污染行业分部财务信息，能减少企业工厂的有毒排放。这一效应与分部披露通过凸显污染分部的财务重要性并吸引利益相关者对其环境影响的关注，从而增强对企业污染的监督这一观点相符。当新披露的分部污染更严重时，该效应更强。披露企业通过实施更好的污染预防措施、减少废物产生以及增加绿色创新来实现这一减排。总体而言，我们的研究强调了强制性财务披露在塑造超出披露信息范围的企业实践中的作用。

title: Life‐cycle living standards of male‐headed households: Evidence from Stockholm, 1800–80
title_zh: 男性户主家庭的生命周期生活水平：来自斯德哥尔摩的证据（1800–1880年）
title_primary: 男性户主家庭的生命周期生活水平：来自斯德哥尔摩的证据（1800–1880年）
title_secondary: Life‐cycle living standards of male‐headed households: Evidence from Stockholm, 1800–80
authors: Anton Svensson
official: 官方在线 2026-01-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Recent research in economic history argues for using a household life cycle standard‐of‐living approach that includes the income and expenses of all household members and considers fluctuations in the household over the life course. This study builds on that approach by empirically examining the development of living standards in male‐headed households in Stockholm 1800–80, linking individuals and their households in the tax records throughout the life cycle. We compile a random sample of approximately 400 male‐headed households to examine how living standards developed and whether they were able to save to mitigate income decline in old age. Distinguishing between manual‐ and non‐manual‐worker households, this study finds that the manual‐worker household size outgrew income in early adulthood, creating a temporary downturn in welfare ratios. Living standards rose in subsequent stages but declined again when the head of the household approached old age. Manual‐worker households suffered a more pronounced decline in income during these later years than non‐manual‐worker households. The latter had better opportunities to smooth consumption over the life cycle by setting money aside, although manual‐worker households that survived into old age had some capacity for small savings, which may have eased but not offset the decline.
abstract_zh: 摘要 近期经济史研究主张采用家庭生命周期生活水平评估方法，该方法涵盖所有家庭成员的收入与支出，并考虑家庭在生命历程中的波动。本研究在此基础上，通过实证考察1800至1880年间斯德哥尔摩以男性为户主的家庭生活水平发展情况，将税收记录中的个体及其家庭贯穿整个生命周期进行关联。我们编制了约400个男性户主家庭的随机样本，以探究生活水平如何演变，以及他们是否能够储蓄以缓解老年期收入下降。通过区分体力劳动者家庭与非体力劳动者家庭，研究发现体力劳动者家庭在成年早期家庭规模增长超过收入，导致福利比率暂时下降。生活水平在后续阶段有所上升，但当户主接近老年时再次下降。体力劳动者家庭在晚年阶段收入下降幅度较非体力劳动者家庭更为显著。后者通过预留资金，在生命周期内平滑消费方面拥有更好条件，尽管存活至老年的体力劳动者家庭具备一定的小额储蓄能力，这可能缓解但未能抵消收入下降的影响。

title: Binary Outcomes and Linear Interactions
title_zh: 二元结果与线性交互
title_primary: 二元结果与线性交互
title_secondary: Binary Outcomes and Linear Interactions
authors: Vincent Boucher, Yann Bramoullé
official: 官方在线 2026-01-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider general models of linear interactions in binary outcomes. We first characterize the conditions under which these models are coherent and complete. Next, we show that models of linear interactions admit sound microfoundations under assumptions of incomplete information and independence. To help guide practitioners, we discuss key modeling choices and testable restrictions. We then consider a specification that is linear in parameters, and propose a simple Two-Stage Least Squares estimator. We revisit the empirical analysis of teenage smoking and peer effects of Lee, Li, and Lin. Our reanalysis highlights the main advantages of the linear framework, including minimal computational and data requirements and ability to handle fixed effects. Supplementary materials for this article are available online.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了二元结果中线性交互作用的一般模型。首先，我们刻画了这些模型具有连贯性和完备性的条件。接着，我们证明在信息不完全和独立性的假设下，线性交互模型能够支持合理的基础微观机制。为便于实践者应用，我们讨论了关键的建模选择及可检验的约束条件。随后，我们考虑了一种参数线性的设定，并提出了一种简单的两阶段最小二乘估计方法。我们重新审视了Lee、Li和Lin关于青少年吸烟与同伴效应的实证分析。我们的再分析凸显了线性框架的主要优势，包括极低的计算与数据需求以及处理固定效应的能力。本文的补充材料可在网上获取。

title: Political Information and Network Effects
title_zh: 政治信息与网络效应
title_primary: 政治信息与网络效应
title_secondary: Political Information and Network Effects
authors: Georgy Egorov, Sergei Guriev, Maxim Mironov, Ekaterina Zhuravskaya, Alexander Copestake 等
official: 官方在线 2025-10-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Why do political campaigns so often yield unexpected results? We address this question by separately estimating the direct effect of a campaign on targeted voters and the indirect effect on others in the same social environment. Partnering with a local NGO during Argentina’s 2023 presidential election, we randomized the distribution of leaflets providing an expert assessment of the consequences of the potentially dangerous proposals by the outsider candidate Javier Milei. Exploiting Argentina’s unique sub-precinct election reporting system, we show that the campaign reduced Milei’s support among directly treated voters, as expected, but increased his support among untreated voters in treated precincts, producing a backfiring, net-positive effect for Milei. A pre-registered replication confirmed these opposite-signed effects. Using theory and a survey experiment, we show that the minority of voters who disbelieved the campaign were more motivated to discuss it with peers, convincing them to support Milei. This mobilization effect appears especially likely when campaigns criticize outsider candidates. Our results highlight how campaigns aimed at anti-elite candidates can unintentionally mobilize support for them.
abstract_zh: 为何政治竞选活动常常产生出人意料的结果？我们通过分别估算竞选活动对目标选民的直接影响，以及对同一社会环境中其他选民的间接影响来探讨这一问题。在阿根廷2023年总统大选期间，我们与一家当地非政府组织合作，随机分发传单，内容为专家对局外人候选人哈维尔·米莱提出的潜在危险提案后果的评估。利用阿根廷独特的次选区选举报告系统，我们发现，该竞选活动如预期般降低了直接受干预选民对米莱的支持率，但反而提高了受干预选区中未受干预选民对他的支持率，从而对米莱产生了适得其反的净正面效应。一项预先注册的复制实验证实了这些符号相反的效应。通过理论分析和调查实验，我们证明，少数不相信该竞选活动的选民更有动力与同伴讨论此事，从而说服他们支持米莱。这种动员效应在竞选活动批评局外人候选人时尤为显著。我们的研究结果凸显了针对反精英候选人的竞选活动如何可能无意中为其动员支持。

title: Committing to Grow: Privatizations and Firm Dynamics in East Germany
title_zh: 承诺增长：东德的私有化与企业动态
title_primary: 承诺增长：东德的私有化与企业动态
title_secondary: Committing to Grow: Privatizations and Firm Dynamics in East Germany
authors: Ufuk Akcigit, Harun Alp, Andre Diegmann, Nicolas Serrano-Velarde
official: 官方在线 2023-09-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates a unique policy designed to maintain employment during the privatization of East German firms after the fall of the Iron Curtain. The policy required new owners of the firms to commit to employment targets, with penalties for non-compliance. Using a dynamic model, we highlight three channels through which employment targets impact firms: distorted employment decisions, increased productivity, and higher exit rates. Our empirical analysis, using a novel dataset and instrumental variable approach, confirms these findings. We estimate a 22% points higher annual employment growth rate, a 14% points higher annual productivity growth, and a 3.6% points higher probability of exit for firms with binding employment targets. Our calibrated model further demonstrates that without these targets, aggregate employment would have been 15% lower after 10 years. Additionally, an alternative policy of productivity investment subsidies proved costly and less effective in the short term.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项旨在铁幕倒塌后东德企业私有化过程中维持就业的特殊政策。该政策要求企业新所有者承诺就业目标，并对未达标者实施处罚。通过构建动态模型，我们揭示了就业目标影响企业的三个渠道：扭曲的雇佣决策、生产率提升以及退出率上升。基于新颖数据集与工具变量法的实证分析证实了上述发现。我们估算出，受约束就业目标的企业年就业增长率高出22个百分点，年生产率增长率高出14个百分点，退出概率高出3.6个百分点。校准模型进一步表明，若无此类目标，十年后总就业量将降低15%。此外，替代性的生产率投资补贴政策在短期内成本高昂且效果欠佳。
